title: Ohio's 14th Congressional District Election, 2026
description: The 2026 race for Ohio's 14th Congressional District pits seven-term Republican incumbent David Joyce against Democratic challenger Maria Jukic. The district covers the northeastern corner of Ohio, including Ashtabula, Geauga, Lake, and Trumbull counties, plus portions of Mahoning and Portage counties. Ohio redrew its congressional map in October 2025, which may affect district dynamics. Joyce, a former Geauga County prosecutor and moderate Republican who chairs the Republican Governance Group, is seeking an eighth term. Jukic, a former Euclid city councilwoman and attorney with two decades of healthcare marketing experience, is making her first run for Congress. The Cook Political Report rated the race as 'Solidly Republican' ahead of the primary.
polling_note: No public opinion polls for this specific race were found as of June 2026. The Cook Political Report rated the district as 'Solidly Republican' prior to the primary.

candidates.name: David Joyce
candidates.summary: David Patrick Joyce has served as the U.S. Representative for Ohio's 14th Congressional District since January 2013. He is a former Geauga County prosecutor who served in that office for 25 years before being elected to Congress. A moderate Republican, he chairs the Republican Governance Group (formerly the Tuesday Group) and serves on the House Committee on Appropriations.

candidates.name: Maria Jukic
candidates.summary: Maria Jukic is an attorney, small business owner, and former Euclid City Councilwoman running for the U.S. House in Ohio's 14th Congressional District. She worked for 24 years in healthcare marketing and administration, including seven years at Euclid Hospital and 17 years directing the Arts and Medicine program at Cleveland Clinic. Jukic won the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026, defeating two opponents to challenge incumbent Rep. David Joyce.

forecast.rationale: No public district-specific polling is available, so this forecast relies entirely on non-polling indicators. Republican incumbent David Joyce is a seven-term officeholder (seeking an eighth term), giving him substantial incumbency and name-recognition advantages. The Cook Political Report rated this seat as 'Solidly Republican' ahead of the primary, indicating a strong GOP baseline. Joyce is a moderate Republican who chairs the Republican Governance Group and has served on the House Appropriations Committee since 2013. Democratic challenger Maria Jukic has relevant local experience as a former Euclid city councilwoman and attorney but is a first-time congressional candidate who only recently won a contested primary. Ohio redrew its congressional map in October 2025, which may affect district dynamics; however, the pre-redistricting 'Solidly Republican' rating and Joyce's longevity in the district suggest the changes are unlikely to fundamentally alter the partisan lean. The absence of polling and the new map keep confidence at medium rather than high, but the safe Republican rating reflects the overwhelming structural advantage indicated by available data.
